press_references.value: Flagright Launches Industry-Leading No-Code Transaction Monitoring Platform

product_launches.description: Flagright introduced a no-code, AI-driven transaction monitoring platform that lets compliance teams build and deploy custom monitoring rules without engineering support, targeting fintechs and banks globally.

press_references.value: Flagright’s secure AI transforms compliance narratives

product_launches.description: Flagright launched a secure, in-house AI platform designed for compliance teams to generate disposition narratives, emphasizing privacy, regulatory alignment, and data security. The platform uses fine-tuned LLMs, anonymized prompts, and robust security protocols to address industry concerns about hallucinations and data leakage.

overview_description.description: Flagright develops an AI-powered platform for anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, transaction monitoring, risk scoring, case management, and regulatory compliance for banks, fintechs, and financial institutions. The company describes its platform as the AI operating system for financial crime compliance and offers AI agents, AI forensics, AI-assisted investigations, and machine-learning-based risk detection capabilities.

about_short_description.short_description: Flagright delivers AI-native transaction monitoring and AML compliance solutions through its highly customizable, API-first platform.

product.name: AI Forensics
product.description: AI agents that execute documented AML and financial-crime procedures for screening, monitoring, investigations, governance, and quality assurance with explainable, auditable outputs.

product.name: Transaction Monitoring
product.description: A real-time and post-event transaction monitoring system for detecting financial crime using configurable, no-code rules, complex aggregations, simulations, and risk-based thresholds.

product.name: Dynamic Risk Scoring
product.description: A configurable risk-scoring system that combines KYC, transaction behavior, and customer risk factors into continuously updated customer risk assessments.

product.name: Case Management
product.description: An AI-enabled workspace for managing alerts, investigations, escalations, approvals, evidence, quality reviews, and suspicious-activity reporting with configurable workflows and audit trails.

product.name: Watchlist Screening
product.description: Configurable screening for sanctions, politically exposed persons, adverse media, and related risk data across real-time and batch customer or transaction checks.

product.name: Regulatory Filing
product.description: A regulatory-reporting solution that drafts, reviews, manages, and submits SARs, STRs, CTRs, and other reports across supported jurisdictions and GoAML frameworks.
